verdict.rationale: Zap workflows are Zapier's own product. Community reports say non-programmers build them and that Zapier supports multiple IF/THEN steps. Canvas offers visual mapping of processes to document and automate them. However, no first-party doc describes building multi-step Zaps in a visual editor; the 'Visual Builder' docs cover building integrations for the App Directory, which is an adjacent feature. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of a visual multi-step Zap editor, explicit evidence of no-code branching/step configuration in that editor, hands-on corroboration of the visual editing experience.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can build multi-step workflows in a visual editor without writing code

citations.quote: Zapier allows more simultaneous IFs & THENs
